headline: Mooring County Tilts Warden as Weathered Expanse Ruins Multiply
war_summary: Since our last edition, Mooring County's ledger has hardened further: nine Warden strongholds now stand against two Colonial, a two-post swing delivered amid the war's steepest two-hour losses, above twelve hundred men to each side. The Weathered Expanse has turned the other way — two more posts lie in ruin, leaving three Warden, two Colonial and four demolished — after ninety-eight actions in the day, Wightwalk again the busiest with thirty-eight, and Warden losses, near eleven thousand three hundred, again the heavier. Stlican Shelf is stirring afresh, Briar's record running to the very hour of this filing. Callahan's Passage has raised no flag since evening, yet its two-hour casualty count climbs steadily. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua, so busy in the last report, has stood still since late evening, and the Nevish Line is likewise quiet on bases even as its daily butcher's bill nears eleven thousand. Day 568 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
